Route 06 Script

FEATURES

Visual System
• Item ESP that highlights all items across the map in real-time
• Displays Item Name, Rarity, and Sell Price information
• Automatic detection when items spawn or disappear
• Randomized highlight colors for better visibility
• Ignore system to skip unwanted items
• Ignored items are clearly marked

Zombie ESP (Esport Style)
• Advanced zombie highlighting visible through walls
• Real-time health bar display
• Live HP counter
• Clean zombie name detection
• Special visual detection for Plague/Boss enemies
• Smooth professional spectator-style UI

Anti Dark Mode
• Removes darkness, fog, rain, blur, and weather effects
• Forces bright daylight environment
• Improves visibility during night or storm events
• Automatically disables rain particles and sounds

Item Teleport System
• Instantly teleport to nearest valuable item
• Automatically prioritizes items with price value or rare rarity
• Safe teleport positioning above ground
• Ignore current item feature to skip unwanted targets
• Reset ignored item list anytime
• Live ignored item counter display

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Combat System
Auto Attack (Head)
• Automatically attacks zombies targeting head/root parts
• Smart distance checking system
• Adjustable attack delay
• Adjustable attack range
• Automatically detects newly spawned zombies
• Multi-target handling with optimized threading

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Movement System
WalkSpeed Modifier
• Fully customizable player speed
• Constant speed enforcement

No Clip
